newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African rand hits all-time low 4.70 vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: S.African rand hits all-time low 4.70 vs dollar.

text.p: The South African rand tumbled to a new all-time low of 4.7000/50 against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday.
By 0805 GMT the currency had slipped further to 4.7050/7100, a loss of 29 percent against the dollar since mid-February.
Dealers said the rand was being hit by speculative sales from both international specualators and domestic importers.

Analysts say investors have been spooked by the country's balance of payments difficulties and the dangerously low level of foreign reserves, which stood at 10.0 billion rand at the end of September, equivalent to four weeks import cover.
